note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Government of Antigua and Barbuda's laws site (laws.gov.ag): the Vehicles and Road Traffic Act, Cap. 460, and the amending Acts listed there (No. 15 of 1995, No. 14 of 2000, No. 13 of 2012, No. 18 of 2018, No. 1 of 2025, published 10 March 2025). s. 36(1)(c) disqualifies a person under 17 from holding or obtaining a driver's licence for a motor vehicle other than a motor cycle or a public service vehicle (16 for a motor cycle, 21 for a public service vehicle), and no amending Act read changes that age (the 2000 Act touches only paragraphs (a) and (e)), so the private driver's licence (s. 31) is held from 17. Term: s. 38 as replaced by the 1995 Act has a licence valid for one year from the holder's date of birth and renewable for one year or, at the holder's request, three years; the term thus depends on the holder's choice and isn't held (validYears null). Fee: s. 33 has the fee of the First Schedule paid on issue; Cap. 460's schedule lists driver's licences for 1 and 3 years but its amounts don't come through in the scan, and the 2025 Act repealed and replaced the First Schedule with one listing only vehicle licence fees: no current driver's licence fee was found, so the fee is null. Issuer: the 2025 Act has the fees paid to the Transport Board and puts the General Manager of the Transport Board for the Commissioner of Inland Revenue in ss. 36, 37 and 39 among others. No identity card and no exchange list are held.
